a.content: The revised travel policy effective June 15 sets the daily allowance at 80 EUR.
a.source: Correction to the travel policy (still effective June 15): the daily allowance is 80 EUR, not what the earlier circular said.

b.content: The travel policy effective June 15 sets the daily allowance at 60 EUR.
b.source: Travel policy effective June 15: daily allowance 60 EUR.

notes: Both sides carry explicit validity naming the SAME effective date; the later-recorded side presents itself as a correction. Before 6.1 the strict direction guard blocked even a clean supersedes verdict here into a human-facing contradiction; the recording-order tie-break fixes the guard, and the update evidence in the source passage carries the verdict.
